relations.title: Order and conflicts
relations.sub: agnts codes several tickets at once and merges them one by one. A ticket waits for the tickets it depends on to be merged, and two tickets that change the same code never code side by side.
relations.waitingSub: Coding starts by itself once these are merged or rejected.
relations.proposedSub: agnts is not sure about these. Accepted ones hold the queue; dismissed ones are never suggested again.
relations.empty: No relations. This ticket runs as soon as a slot is free.
relations.removeConfirm: {key} and {other} will no longer wait for each other. Continue?
relations.basis_codegen: Both change the API spec or generated code
relations.basis_diff: The finished changes touch the same lines in {files}
relations.addHint: Waits for: this ticket starts coding once the other is merged. Not alongside: whichever starts second waits until the first is merged.
relations.footprintSub: What the analysis expects this ticket to change. agnts compares footprints to keep colliding tickets apart.
relations.markMergedHint: No merge webhook? Mark the pull request merged so tickets waiting for it can start.
